subject: Vendor settlement onboarding: payment channels, remittance contact & docs
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: mark.evans@northforge.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor settlement onboarding: payment channels, remittance contact & docs

Hi Mark —

Welcome — excited to get NorthForge set up with Redwood. To make the procurement/payment onboarding smooth, can you please confirm the items below or attach them to a reply? No need to include full PDFs in-line; a couple of short attachments (W-9, bank verification) and the answers below will get us moving.

Required items / questions:
- Legal company name and billing address (as it should appear on invoices)
- Preferred payment channels: ACH (Direct Deposit) or Wire (or both). If ACH, please confirm whether you want ACH credits and include bank routing + account number, or a TPS/enrollment form if you use a payment processor.
- Remittance contact: email and name for remittance notifications (where we should send remittance advices/PO numbers)
- Invoice submission method: email to a specific inbox, vendor portal URL, or SFTP (please provide link/credentials if portal/SFTP)
- Invoice requirements: do you require a PO number on invoices? Any mandatory line items/formats?
- Payment terms requested (Net 30/Net 45/etc) and whether you accept early-pay discounts
- Tax form: W-9 or local equivalent
- Bank proof: voided check or bank letter for account verification (PDF)

Optional but helpful: sample invoice PDF (1 page), and any DocuSign link if you prefer to complete an ACH authorization electronically.

We typically issue POs for orders >$5k; invoices without a PO may be routed through manual review which can delay payment. Once we receive this bundle we’ll create a vendor profile and queue the first test payment.

Thanks — can you aim to send these by end of week? I’ll loop in Finance (Ben) once we have the bank proof.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0146

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers below and I attached a bank letter + our AP contact details.

- Legal name: NorthForge Inc., 301 Industrial Way, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110
- Preferred payment channel: ACH credit preferred (faster, no wire fees). We can do wire for one-off exceptions.
- Remittance contact: Nora Patel <nora.patel@northforge.io> (remits@northforge.io) — Nora is copied on our internal thread below.
- Invoice submission: we accept emailed invoices to remits@northforge.io and also have a vendor portal at https://portal.northforge.io/invoices (we can provide a portal setup token if you want us to ingest POs).
- PO number: We can accept invoices without PO for the first 60 days. After that, PO numbers are required for orders > $2500.
- Payment terms requested: Net 30 (standard)
- Tax form: Attached W-9 (northforge_w9.pdf)
- Bank proof: Attached bank letter (northforge_bank_letter.pdf) and voided check image (voided_check.jpg)

A couple of clarifying Qs for you:
1) Does Redwood support ACH with remittance advices (i.e., can you include invoice references on the ACH trace)?
2) Do you require vendor enrollment via DocuSign for ACH or is the bank letter sufficient?

I’ve attached the W-9 and bank letter. Let me know if you need anything signed — we can complete a DocuSign form as well.

Best,
Mark Evans
Head of Finance Operations
NorthForge Inc.
mark.evans@northforge.io
+1 (617) 555-7201

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: mark.evans@northforge.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2025 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor settlement onboarding: payment channels, remittance contact & docs

Hi Mark —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments — those look good. To your questions:

1) ACH remittance: Yes, our payouts team can include invoice references in ACH descriptions for most banks (we add the invoice number in the trace field). For full remittance advices (PDFs) we’ll send a remittance email to the remits inbox you provided.

2) Enrollment: A bank verification letter plus a signed ACH enrollment form is our preferred minimum. Bank letters are acceptable for account verification, but Finance will ask for a signed ACH enrollment form (we can send a DocuSign). I’m attaching the enrollment template to this thread and will send a DocuSign link if that’s easiest for you.

One more internal note: we require PO numbers on invoices for anything over $5k in our system. I can set up an exception per your ask to allow no-PO invoices for 60 days with manual routing. Please confirm if that works.

If everything looks good I’ll create the vendor profile and route to Finance for verification. Ben, can you confirm timing for a first test ACH once we have the signed enrollment form?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachments: ach_enrollment_template.pdf (stub)
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, mark.evans@northforge.io
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor settlement onboarding: payment channels, remittance contact & docs

Hi all —

Thanks — I reviewed the bank letter and W-9. To confirm Redwood’s process and timing:
- Required: signed ACH enrollment form (DocuSign OK) OR bank letter + voided check for first-time ACH payees. You have both; we still need the enrollment signed.
- Test payment: once enrollment is signed, Finance schedules a $0 or $1 micro-deposit verification OR we initiate a $5 test ACH depending on the bank. We will coordinate with Nora to confirm once the test posts.
- Wire option: available but note vendors typically bear wire receiving fees on their side. If you prefer wire for a one-off, indicate which invoices should be wired.
- Terms: Net 45 is Redwood’s standard for new vendors. We can approve Net 30 for established partners or on a pilot agreement. Mark — are you able to accept Net 45 for the first 90 days and then reevaluate for Net 30? If not, we can add early-payment discount language (e.g., 2% 10) to move closer to Net 30 economics.

Next step: Mark, please sign the ACH enrollment DocuSign (link below). Once signed, I’ll create the vendor in the AP system and schedule the verification.

DocuSign: https://na.docusign.net/ABCDE12345

Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks everyone —

Nora confirmed she’ll sign the ACH enrollment via DocuSign this afternoon. We’re fine with Redwood doing a small verification deposit. Net 45 for the first 90 days works for us; we appreciate the clarification.

We dropped the requested documents into the DocuSign envelope and uploaded the W-9/bank letter to your shared drive link as well. Please confirm receipt once the vendor record is created and we’ll look out for the test ACH.

Best,
Mark
